hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | grep -qE "(^|/)(source|bin)/[^/]+$" && jq -nc --arg m "This edit touched source/ or bin/. If it added, removed, renamed, or changed the signature of a user-facing alias, function, or script, add or update its tip under tips/ as part of this same change — see the writing-tips skill. Internal helpers with no user-facing surface need no tip." '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$m}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.md) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; out=$("${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"/bin/check-md-limits "$f" 2>&1) || true; [ -n "$out" ] && jq -nc --arg m "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$m}}'; } || true
